reviewSamples.author: Photo of Amber Szedlar
reviewSamples.text: Jared and Cody did an excellent job detailing my car.  They took their time and were thorough with the exterior wash and wax and the interior was nicely cleaned.  I feel like I have a brand new car.  Will definitely use All Pro again and will refer others to use them as well.  Thank you for a job well done!
